thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need a tight checklist for GA handoff that covers SLAs, docs, support routing, monitoring retention, and pricing edge cases. Can owners call out gaps?

Devon Chu: ok. I'll own SLA playbook draft. need clarity on SLO targets vs. enforcement (alerts vs. automatic fallback).

Ravi Kapoor: Pricing ops here — main gap: how we bill for fallback to cheaper model variants + token rounding for streaming responses. also customer credits flow if we miss p99.

Jen Torres: Monitoring question — retention for traces/logs. Ops wants 90 days for traces, but product-facing dashboards only need 30. Thoughts?

Priya (Legal): two legal points: (1) SLA remedies in contract templates must map to the SLO metrics we expose in Console; (2) we need an opt-in checkbox for customers who want limited retention (GDPR/region). won't approve GA language until those map.

Devon Chu: noted @Priya. SLA draft will include metric-to-contract mapping section. proposed SLOs: p50 < 100ms, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms for hosted tier. Can we confirm fallback policy that preserves p95?

Maya Patel: fallback policy: try same-family lower-capacity variant, then regional fallback, then queued degrade with customer-visible header. We should record this in docs + runbook.

Ravi Kapoor: billing: proposal: (a) charge tokens at model actually served, with rounding up per 100 tokens for streaming chunks; (b) on fallback, bill at the lower model rate and log an event for customer billing reports. need product + finance signoff.

Jen Torres: retention compromise: 30d traces for product, 90d for infra; include redaction rules for sensitive prompt/response fields. Ops can keep 90d raw but product dashboard will surface aggregated metrics only.

Priya (Legal): redaction rule OK. For opt-in limited retention, we need UI consent flow and a data-processing addendum flag. Add to the GA checklist.

Deploy Bot: Deploy plan posted: canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100%, 24h hold between steps. Auto-rollback on increased error-rate > 1.5x baseline.

Maya Patel: good. Need runbook snippets for the auto-rollback path and manual rollbacks with oncall paging. Also call out customer communication templates for degraded mode.

Devon Chu: adding runbook section draft. snippet: ```
# Auto-rollback triggers
if error_rate > baseline * 1.5 for 15m -> trigger rollback
notify #eng-oncall, send incident ticket
```

Ravi Kapoor: what about invoice adjustments? we should define a visible "credit" line item and automated application for customers with active contracts. if not, manual CS process will explode.

Priya (Legal): contract language must allow automated credits; Finance needs to confirm limits. Also require audit trail for any credit applied.

Jen Torres: monitoring alerting plan: "Ops" gets infra-level alerts (90d traces); Product gets signal-aggregates (30d). We also need a quality-monitor that tracks generation quality regressions tied to prompt test-suite.

Maya Patel: ok action items: (1) Devon — SLA + runbook draft + metric->contract map (owner) (2) Jen — monitoring retention & quality-monitor spec (owner) (3) Ravi — billing fallback rules + credit automation spec (owner) (4) Priya — contract flag + DPA wording (owner) (5) Ops (cc: @DevEx) — customer-facing degraded-mode templates + support routing map. Please post PRs by EOD Wednesday.

Devon Chu: I'll open PR against /docs/ga-readiness with SLA table + runbook snippet today.

Ravi Kapoor: I'll draft billing flow and a stub for finance to approve.

Jen Torres: putting monitoring spec in the repo and flagging the trace retention toggle.

Priya (Legal): will circulate contract language and DPA patch for review.

Maya Patel: thanks — final note: add an "observability cost" line in the pricing docs so customers know the retention tradeoffs. We'll review PRs in Thursday triage. :thumbsup:
